comment: Clinically-authored companion suggestions for the picker. PRINCIPLE (Oscar, 2026-07-14): suggest the PATHWAY, not just sibling leaflets — (1) the service/contact page (who to call: the epilepsy nurse via Neurology, the AHOU helpline), (2) the ambulatory route back in (SDEC, EPAU), (3) the safety-netting sheet (sepsis, cauda equina), (4) the discharge medicine. When a ticked item's folded title contains a `match` term, each `suggest` entry is resolved through the normal search scoring against the CURRENT trust's items — so suggestions adapt per trust and silently drop when a trust has no matching content. Bundles are concepts, not slugs: never hardcode slugs (they are per-trust). Shown as a subtle 'Often given together' row; the clinician decides. MEDICINE BUNDLES (Oscar 2026-09-03: 'link common treatments to conditions — bring up flucloxacillin when cellulitis is selected'): each presentation suggests its usual first-line discharge medicine(s) as NHS.uk medicine pages, and the medicine suggests its condition back. Suggestions prompt the clinician and never prescribe; suggestions are not clinical approvals — the clinician chooses every item (Oscar 2026-09-03); from here the set grows from what clinicians actually pick together (learned_bundles.json).
